title: Standard Proficiency Test
description: A mixed bag of 25 questions to test general knowledge and logic.

questions.question: What is the capital of France?
questions.subject: Geography
questions.explanation: Paris is the capital and most populous city of France.

questions.question: Which of these are primary colors?
questions.subject: Art
questions.explanation: Red, Blue, and Yellow are the primary colors in the RYB color model.

questions.question: What is 15 + 27?
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.question: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.subject: Science
questions.explanation: Mars is often called the Red Planet because of iron oxide on its surface.

questions.question: Select the even numbers.
questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.explanation: Even numbers are divisible by 2.

questions.question: What is the square root of 64?
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.question: Who wrote 'Romeo and Juliet'?
questions.subject: Literature
questions.explanation: William Shakespeare wrote the tragedy Romeo and Juliet early in his career.

questions.question: Which of these are gases at room temperature?
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.explanation: Oxygen and Nitrogen are gases, while Gold is solid and Mercury is liquid at room temperature.

questions.question: What is 100 divided by 4?
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.question: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.subject: Geography
questions.explanation: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth's oceanic divisions.

questions.question: Identify the prime numbers.
questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.explanation: Prime numbers have only two divisors: 1 and themselves.

questions.question: How many continents are there?
questions.subject: Geography
questions.explanation: There are seven continents: Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe, and Australia.

questions.question: What is the chemical symbol for water?
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.explanation: H2O represents two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

questions.question: Which of these are mammals?
questions.subject: Biology
questions.explanation: Whales and Elephants are mammals; sharks are fish and eagles are birds.

questions.question: What is 7 * 9?
questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.explanation: 7 times 9 equals 63.

questions.question: Who painted the Mona Lisa?
questions.subject: Art
questions.explanation: Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa in the early 16th century.

questions.question: Which elements are in the halogen group?
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.explanation: Fluorine and Chlorine are halogens; Neon and Argon are noble gases.

questions.question: What is the boiling point of water in Celsius?
questions.subject: Science
questions.explanation: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at standard atmospheric pressure.

questions.question: What is the smallest unit of life?
questions.subject: Biology
questions.explanation: The cell is the basic structural, functional, and biological unit of all known organisms.

questions.question: Which of these countries are in Asia?
questions.subject: Geography
questions.explanation: Japan and India are in Asia; Brazil is in South America and Egypt is in Africa.

questions.question: How many sides does a hexagon have?
questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.explanation: A hexagon is a polygon with six sides.

questions.question: Which gas do plants absorb from the atmosphere?
questions.subject: Biology
questions.explanation: Plants absorb carbon dioxide for photosynthesis.

questions.question: Which of these are programming languages?
questions.subject: Technology
questions.explanation: Java and Python are programming languages; HTML is a markup language and HTTP is a protocol.

questions.question: What is the value of 2 to the power of 5?
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.question: Which is the fastest land animal?
questions.subject: Biology
questions.explanation: The cheetah can reach speeds up to 70 mph (113 km/h).
